elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Stop clicking Allow when a website wants to send notifications.

[confident] Here's the fix. Block site notifications for good.

[friendly] In Chrome Settings, open Privacy and security. Tap Site settings, then Notifications. Pick Don't allow sites to send notifications. Then block any site in the Allowed list.

[delighted] No more junk popping up in the corner.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
